description: Browse and search products from the barber and beauty supply stores that sell through ShearQuery: Atlanta Barber & Beauty Supply (clippers, trimmers, blades, shears, razors, disinfectant, capes, chairs) and Brighton Beauty Supply (professional hair color, developer, lightener, gel polish, nail tools, hair care), with price, stock and options. With no arguments it lists the stores. With query (and optionally store, category, in_stock_only, page) it returns matching products, each a [name](page) link with a product_id. With product_id it returns that product's details and OPTIONS (sizes, blades, colors), each with its own price and stock. When you list products, keep each one's [name](page) link exactly as given: the page is where the member sees the pictures and options. To buy, add items to their cart (update_supply_cart) or ask for a quote (request_supply_quote); nothing is bought by browsing.

category.description: A category name from an earlier result.

in_stock_only.description: Leave out sold-out products. Defaults to true.

page.description: Page of results, 12 per page. Defaults to 1.

product_id.description: One product's id from an earlier result, for its details and options.

query.description: The member's own product words, brand AND model together, e.g. 'andis talon', 'wahl magic clip', 'wella koleston', 'welloxon 20 volume'. Never shorten to the brand alone: 'andis' alone returns 136 products and buries the one they named.

store.description: A store's name or slug, to search only that store.

name: shop_supplies
title: Browse barber and beauty supply store products
